## Lumen 1.7.0 — plays practically anything

Made with ♥ by Shane Sahadeo.

### Download

| Your PC | Installer | Portable |
|---|---|---|
| Most Windows PCs (Intel / AMD) | **Lumen-Setup-1.7.0-x64.exe** | **Lumen-1.7.0-portable-x64.zip** |
| Windows on ARM (Snapdragon, Surface Pro X / 11) | **Lumen-Setup-1.7.0-arm64.exe** | **Lumen-1.7.0-portable-arm64.zip** |

- **Installer:** per-user (no admin prompt), Start menu, *Open with* and Default Apps registration, optional desktop shortcut.
- **Portable:** unzip anywhere and run `Lumen.exe`; keep the `engine` folder next to it.

Windows SmartScreen may warn the first time because the files aren't code-signed yet: *More info → Run anyway*.

### What's new
- **Extended engine:** files Windows' built-in player can't handle now play automatically through a bundled libmpv + FFmpeg engine (LGPL builds): AVI/DivX/Xvid, WMV, MPEG, VOB, TS/M2TS, FLV, HEVC, Dolby Digital, DTS and TrueHD audio, APE, WMA and more, plus Blu-ray/DVD subtitles and full ASS styling.
- Everything works on both engines: seek previews, chapters, tracks, subtitle styling, adjustments, EQ, zoom, rotation, ambient light, statistics, snapshots, thumbnails.
- Settings → General → *Playback engine*: Automatic, Always extended, or Built-in only.
- Dropped files open with their real paths.

The engine's libraries are LGPL-2.1-or-later (and permissive) builds made from source by `.github/workflows/engine.yml`; licenses and source links are in `engine\THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt`.
